stage: serialize native TCP prefix consumption across reentrant user release callbacks
state: verified correctness stage; four products developing; original goal active
behavior: A worker-only WriteConsuming flag spans buffer consumption and exact byte-credit return. Reentrant sends can append but cannot drive the same already-sent prefix. The enclosing readiness/completion driver resumes FIFO writes.

No added allocation, lock, queue, shared runtime or public API. The added private bool occupies existing padding in all six measured platform/profile pairs; private bool offsets change, sizeof Stream and following aligned members do not.

Seven real-loopback scenarios cover copied and batch-ref appends, a single initial ref, close/abort from releaser and high/low-water appends; peer bytes/order, original release pointer/size, exactly-once callbacks, zero pending credit and actual physical retirement are asserted.
Regression is registered under net_tcp_retire plus explicit Windows IOCP and Linux io_uring test-only modules; single header regenerated from authoritative source.
